highlight: The bar now hides only in macOS Full Screen, not when a window simply fills the screen.
items: Maximise a window, zoom it, or use Fill, and the bar stays right where it is. It steps aside only when you choose Full Screen from the green button (or press Ctrl+Cmd+F), and comes back the moment you leave.
Apps that draw over the whole screen (an AI agent's cursor, an annotation or dimming tool) no longer make the bar disappear. 0.1.10 took them for full-screen video.
With two displays, Full Screen on the other one leaves your bar alone.

highlight: Fixes a crash shortly after launch in 0.1.9.
items: 0.1.9 quit on its own a few seconds after starting. Sorry about that. This one stays up.
Everything 0.1.9 brought is here: the bar stepping aside for full-screen video, stray windows tucked away, one-click updates.
From now on, every release has to run for 30 seconds without a hiccup before it ships.
When something goes full screen, the floating bar fades out of the way and comes back when you leave.
Windows that sneak back onto the screen from another group (looking at you, Slack) are tucked away again.
Updates arrive with a small dot on the menu-bar icon. One click, and you're on the new version, permissions and groups intact.
Focus brings rain by default, Lock In if you have DesktopHQ, or a track of your own.
DesktopHQ2 is now signed and notarized by Apple, so it opens like any other app. No more Terminal tricks.

highlight: Meet Tidy: one keystroke, and every window in the group gets a little breathing room.
items: Hyper+T spaces the active group's windows evenly, leaving the floating bar clear.
Borrow a window from another group as a guest, and send it home when you're done.
Cmd+Tab now stays inside the group you're in.
Focus, Awake and Bookmarks live in your bar, a click away.
